content.title: What it takes to construct an AI data center, Hut 8 CEO outlines
content.description:
Hut 8 Corp. (HUT) unveiled its own partnership with Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) and Fluidstack to build an AI data center in Louisiana. Alphabet's Google (GOOG, GOOGL) is providing the backstop on this latter deal.

Hut 8 CEO Asher Genoot joins Yahoo Finance executive editor Brian Sozzi to further discuss the logistics behind constructing the data center, designing the systems inside the facility, and Google's credit history that ultimately enabled this deal.

Also watch Asher Genoot explain some of the details of the data center deal and Google's invaluable role in securing it.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Opening Bid.
